active_continuity: At least three hundred attackers entered Chengdu in government-troop disguises and are approaching the Sichuan Tang Clan.
Tang Sadok has mobilized the entire Tang Clan and armed every member with poison and hidden weapons.
The Tang War Drum has sounded, signaling that the Tang Clan faces a potential destruction-level attack.
The Tang Clan's Ten Wonders have gathered to follow Tang Sadok's orders.
The Master of the Gatekeeper Pavilion is Tang Sadok's only nephew, whose father died during the Gyeongwol Year Bloodbath.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord infiltrated the Tang Clan in disguise and uses an unexplained demonic martial art to alter his body.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord lost his left arm while fighting Tang Taesang; his restored left arm has impaired sensation.
open_questions: What are the limits and nature of the Western Heaven Demon Lord's demonic martial art?
How many attackers are in the force beyond the roughly three hundred identified by the Green Shadow Squad?
Can the Sichuan Tang Clan survive the approaching assault?
What will result from the confrontation between Tang Sadok, the Tang Clan's Ten Wonders, and the Western Heaven Demon Lord?
